source.title: Ministry of Home Affairs (Government of India), Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) page
source.fact_used: 112 is India's single emergency number (ERSS: 'One India One Emergency Number 112').
source.reuse_note: MHA's website policy does not allow reproducing its content without permission, so no MHA text is bundled. Only the number and a one-line fact in AuraHealth's own words are used, with this reference.

guidance_note: No medical guidance is bundled for India in this prototype: no authoritative source was found whose reuse terms allow bundling AND that has been reviewed for this use. AuraHealth shows an honest 'cannot assess' message instead.
